replace_model_linears_with_fp8: replace all torch.nn.Linear modules in a PyTorch model with FP8Linear modules for fp8 quantization
create_fp8_linear_layer: create an FP8Linear layer with configurable block size and dynamic or static activation scheme
quantize_weights_to_fp8: quantize fp32 weight tensors to fp8 format with per-tile inverse scales using Fp8Quantize
dequantize_fp8_weights_to_fp32: dequantize fp8 weight tensors back to fp32 using inverse scales with Fp8Dequantize
review_fp8_quantization_config: review the FP8Linear class to understand block size and activation scheme parameters for quantization
